non_comparable_preflight_attempts.root_cause: The draft represented both 16384x128 uint8 elements and 128-byte element width, so B2ND expected 256 MiB rather than the actual 2 MiB.
non_comparable_preflight_attempts.resolution: Persist 16384 fixed-width S128 descriptor records. This retains the logical [16384,128] bytes and lets official SHUFFLE plus BYTEDELTA operate on all 128 lanes.
